```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE)
```

# R Markdown

This is a Quarto document with R code. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
fit <- lm(dist ~ speed, data = cars)
fit
```

# Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
#| label: fig-pie
#| fig-cap: "A fancy pie chart."

par(mar = c(0, 1, 0, 1))
pie(
  c(280, 60, 20),
  c('Sky', 'Sunny side of pyramid', 'Shady side of pyramid'),
  col = c('#0292D8', '#F7EA39', '#C4B632'),
  init.angle = -50, border = NA
)
```

See @fig-pie for the result.
